title: Kaariyavadhi
desc: A shrewd man runs a market to solely reap its profits. Soon, a young man falls in love with his daughter and stands against his authoritative rule.

title: Oh Baby
desc: A seventy-year-old woman frustrated with her life, blames God for her misfortune. Subsequently, she magically transforms into a twenty-four-year-old after getting her photo taken at a studio.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Sangathalaivan
desc: A humble textile worker meets a staunch Communist after a tragic incident. Subsequently, he joins the movement after enduring exploitation, sparking a fight for workers' rights.

title: Mannarkudi Veeran
desc: Siddhartha, a courageous District Commissioner, goes against a notorious local politician.

title: Ennodu Modhi Paar
desc: Karthikeya, a man who is devoted to his family, faces a huge challenge as his violent and turbulent past begins to resurface.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Naveena Saraswathi Sabatham
desc: Lord Shiva hijacks four friends' bachelor party with the intention of recruiting them. As a result, they wake up on a deserted island with no memory of how they got there.

title: Sivakumarin Sabadham
desc: A man belongs to a weaver's family and strives to overcome multiple challenges in order to make his dreams come true of setting up a textile company.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Thandatti
desc: Subramani, almost retired, goes on a hunt to find her missing grandmother. However, the search creates more trouble for Subramani than she expected.

title: Katamarayudu
desc: In an attempt to give up his violent past, a man decides to change himself for the woman he loves. Soon, when his lover's family is threatened by evil forces, he takes matters into his own hands.

title: Bullet Raja
desc: Raja, a common man who falls prey to a flawed system and becomes a feared gangster. His friend Rudra joins him in his fight against the police, government and industrialists.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.
